novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanistic relationship—“the user-belief direction dominates the model's own truth direction” while the truth remains “known” internally—rather than merely a new setting, although its proposed probing and projection methods are standard activation-steering tools. Searches using “sycophancy user belief internal representation,” “sycophancy truth channel override,” “LLM sycophancy activation steering,” “honesty knowledge internal representation,” and “belief fact conflation language models” found Perez et al. (2022), Sharma et al. (2023) / “Towards Understanding Sycophancy in Language Models,” and recent honesty-steering work such as “Depth-Wise Activation Steering for Honest Language Models,” but these address behavioral sycophancy or truthful reporting and do not establish the specific two-channel user-belief-versus-truth competition. The step from those works to this claim therefore requires a new core relationship, not a direct transfer, though the causal intervention itself is a natural application of existing steering methods; this supports high but not paradigm-level novelty.
